title: Poached Turkey Tacos
description: A twist on traditional Mexican tacos, this dish features poached turkey, creamy sauce, and a touch of garlicky flavor.
instructions: 1. In a large saucepan, combine poaching liquid ingredients. Heat over medium heat.
2. Add the turkey breast to the saucepan. Poach for 15-20 minutes.
3. While the turkey is cooking, prepare the creamy sauce by mixing it with chopped cilantro and lime juice.
4. Once the turkey is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes.
5. Slice the turkey into thin strips.
6. Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
7. Assemble the tacos by placing a few slices of the poached turkey onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of the creamy sauce and a sprinkle of salsa.
8. Garnish with additional cilantro and serve immediately.
